brief:
The Palestinian Centre for Human Rights reported that Israeli Occupation Forces are conducting widespread and systematic attacks against Palestinian civilians throughout the Gaza Strip, targeting homes, displacement tents, shelters, civilian gatherings, and civilian vehicles.

The organization said these attacks form part of a comprehensive policy aimed at destroying the essentials of life in Gaza. The campaign involves mass killings and the widespread destruction of civilian infrastructure and property across the territory.
dek: The Israeli Occupation Forces (IOF) continue to carry out widespread and systematic attacks against Palestinian civilians throughout the Gaza Strip by targeting homes, displacement tents, shelters, civilian gatherings, and civilian vehicles. These attacks form part of a comprehensive policy aimed at destroying the essentials of life in the Gaza Strip through mass killings, widespread destruction,.
title: Israeli forces intensify attacks on Gaza civilians, rights group says
